doc_metadata.title: TC-01.5 — User Profile
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to the Profile page by clicking on the avatar or visiting /profile. The profile page shows user details and allows editing contact information.

doc_metadata.title: TC-01.5 — Profile Details
doc_metadata.caption: The profile page displays the current user's information including username, email, role, and employee linkage. Users can update their contact details and password.
